title: Meesho CEO buys ₹83.81-crore villa plots from Byju Raveendran's family in Bengaluru | Wipro's Rishad Premji also lives in the locality | Inshorts
text:
Meesho CEO buys ₹83.81-crore villa plots from Byju Raveendran's family in Bengaluru 
 Menu English हिन्दी Categories For the best experience use inshorts app on your smartphone Meesho CEO buys ₹83.81-crore villa plots from Byju Raveendran's family in Bengaluru
 short by Ashley Paul / 07:12 pm on Monday, 16 November 2026 Meesho CEO Vidit Aatrey purchased two side-by-side villa plots in Bengaluru's Epsilon Residential Villas township for ₹83.81 crore, according to Zapkey. The plots were sold by Divya Gokulnath and Deeptha Akhila Raghavan, wives of BYJU'S Founder Byju Raveendran and his brother Riju. The two plots together measure 33,485 square feet, translating to an acquisition cost of ₹25,029/square foot. read more at Moneycontrol Inshorts Pte. Ltd.
